newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel slips on renewed Thomson offer.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel slips on renewed Thomson offer.

text.p: Shares in Alcatel Alsthom were 1.45 percent lower at 455.40 francs at 1009 GMT on concerns it may renew its bid for state-owned electronics group Thomson.
Meanwhile the CAC index eased 0.26 percent.
"It's bringing back a factor of uncertainty and investors do not like that," a dealer commented Alcatel Alsthom's easing.

Alcatel chairman Serge Tchuruk told a parliamentary commission last week during a closed session, of which minutes were published on Tuesday, that his company was ready to make a new offer for Thomson after a December 31 expiry date for the current preferred bid by Lagardere.
